f102b31021d8549dc50aa13fe88a4909d1a921f8.sourceText: 这来自北极熊原包的设计：先用一个朝向较稳定的虚拟系供导航计算，再把速度转换到实际云台系；`cmd_spin` 用于叠加底盘自旋。[北极熊原包说明](https://github.com/SMBU-PolarBear-Robotics-Team/pb2025_sentry_nav/blob/main/fake_vel_transform/README.md)、[原包速度转换源码](https://github.com/SMBU-PolarBear-Robotics-Team/pb2025_sentry_nav/blob/main/fake_vel_transform/src/fake_vel_transform.cpp)。这是这套工程的约定，不能认为所有 ROS2 的 `cmd_vel` 都按云台系表达。
f102b31021d8549dc50aa13fe88a4909d1a921f8.translatedText: This comes from the design of the original Polaris package: first use a relatively stable virtual frame for navigation calculations, then convert the velocity into the actual gimbal frame;`cmd_spin` used to superimpose chassis spin\.[Polaris original package description](https://github.com/SMBU-PolarBear-Robotics-Team/pb2025_sentry_nav/blob/main/fake_vel_transform/README.md)、[original package velocity conversion source code](https://github.com/SMBU-PolarBear-Robotics-Team/pb2025_sentry_nav/blob/main/fake_vel_transform/src/fake_vel_transform.cpp)。This is the convention of this project; it cannot be assumed that all ROS2's `cmd_vel` are expressed in the gimbal frame\.

    10.  CAN报文发送函数调用

    ```cpp
    int16_t Current_Motor_Target[1];

    void chassis_task(void const * argument)
    {
      //wait a time
      //空闲一段时间
      vTaskDelay(20);  //等待所有设备准备就绪

      while(1)   //可以在定时器中断里实现
      {
        Current_Motor_Target[0] = 1000;    //测试电机闭环是否可用的代码，正式使用时请注释该行代码
        CAN1_CMD_1(Current_Motor_Target[0],0,0,0);  //对电调ID为1的电机发送1000电流使其开环转动。
        //系统延时
        vTaskDelay(2);  //等同于osDelay(2);      
      }

    }
    ```

6.  大疆电机库闭环代码解析：库由往届学长学姐对大疆官方库代码修改后的。（在开环基础上又加了CAN报文接收，以及一系列数据解析程序）

    1.  CAN通信接收中断回调函数(CAN_RX0接收中断回调函数用来处理CAN通信电机发来的数据，也就是 **电机的速度，角度，温度** 等数据。)

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image193.webp)

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image194.webp)![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image195.webp)

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image196.webp)

    6.  数据解析函数

        1.  电机编码器分为增量式编码器和绝对值编码器

            1.  增量式编码器：上电时数据会丢失，角度从0开始

            2.  绝对值编码器：掉电后数据不会丢失。

            3.  M3508和M2006编码器都为绝对值编码器，掉电后数据不会丢失，但是因为记录的是转子的角度，转子连接了一个减速器，所以导致数据是错误的，所以我们要用代码将绝对值编码器的数据转化为增量式编码器的数据来使用。(结构体里的total是绝对编码器的角度，而total_angle是我们处理后改为增量式编码器的总角度)

        2.  记录上电角度

        ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image197.webp)

        4.  计算总角度（经代码处理后，上电时总角度 = 圈数(0) \*8192 + 当前绝对值编码器的角度(假设为A) - 上电时捕获到的上电角度(因为此时为上电时，所以也为A) = 0）

        ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image198.webp)

    int16_t Current_Motor_Target[1];

    void chassis_task(void const * argument)

      //wait a time

6.  DJI Motor Library Closed\-Loop Code Analysis: The library is a modification of the official DJI library code by previous senior students\. (On top of the open\-loop version, CAN message reception and a series of data parsing programs have been added\.)

    1.  CAN Communication Receive Interrupt Callback Function (CAN_RX0 The receive interrupt callback function is used to process the data sent by the CAN communication motor, that is, the **motor's speed, angle, temperature** and other data\.)

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image193.webp)

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image194.webp)![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image195.webp)

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image196.webp)

    6.  Data Parsing Function

        1.  Motor encoders are divided into incremental encoders and absolute value encoders\.

            1.  Incremental encoder: data is lost upon power\-up, and the angle starts from 0\.

            2.  Absolute value encoder: data is not lost after power\-down\.

            3.  The encoders of the M3508 and M2006 are both absolute value encoders, and data is not lost after power\-down\. However, because what is recorded is the rotor's angle, and the rotor is connected to a reducer, the data is erroneous\. Therefore, we need to use code to convert the absolute value encoder data into incremental encoder data for use\. (The total in the struct is the absolute encoder's angle, and total_angle is the total angle we processed and changed to the incremental encoder's total angle\.)

        2.  Record the power\-up angle

        ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image197.webp)

        4.  Calculate the total angle (after code processing, at power\-up the total angle = number of turns (0) \\\*8192 \+ the current absolute value encoder angle (assumed to be A) \- the power\-up angle captured at power\-up (because this is at power\-up, it is also A) = 0)\.

        ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image198.webp)
